responsibility: Defines the ISO system-clock interface for gm2, including the DateTime record and constrained scalar types that describe calendar date, time of day, fractional seconds, UTC offset, and summer-time status. It declares capability queries for reading and setting the host clock, validation of DateTime values, and procedures to fetch or update local system time, forming the public time-of-day API above the lower-level wrapclock bindings.
same_name_distinction: This .def file defines the public clock-facing types and procedures—DateTime plus capability, validation, get, and set operations—while SysClock.mod performs the real conversion to and from host clock primitives.
